# https://surrealdb.com/docs/

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/

SurrealDB is a multi-model database designed to simplify building modern applications. It combines the capabilities of traditional relational databases, document stores, graph databases, and more into a single, unified platform. Whether you are building real-time applications, working with complex data relationships, or deploying AI-powered workflows, SurrealDB provides the tools you need without requiring multiple database systems.
##  Learn[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#learn)
The SurrealDB documentation contains a large number of guides, each designed to address different aspects of database management and application development.
[ ![Querying](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/a22c2665236646b0.Djgx3T8Z.webp)![Querying](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/a22c2665236646b0.Djgx3T8Z.webp)Querying Learn to query your data with SurrealQL, SDKs or GraphQL.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/querying)[ ![Schema management](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/f37dbfada942efa3.hfPf6RiW.webp)![Schema management](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/f37dbfada942efa3.hfPf6RiW.webp)Schema management Learn how to shape data in SurrealDB using tables, fields, indexes, events, functions, and more.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/schema-management)[ ![Data models](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/fa714ddbf26326ed.DNLeHdTf.webp)![Data models](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/fa714ddbf26326ed.DNLeHdTf.webp)Data models Store and query document, graph, vector, time-series, and geospatial data with SurrealDB.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/data-models)[ ![Security](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/037a996120148e0b.BE0jwzny.webp)![Security](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/037a996120148e0b.BE0jwzny.webp)Security Learn how to strengthen your SurrealDB deployment with best security practices.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/security)[ ![Spectron](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/be88a0e1bc590985.D2p0zt_9.webp)![Spectron](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/be88a0e1bc590985.D2p0zt_9.webp)Spectron Learn how to use Spectron, the memory context for AI agents.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/spectron)[ ![Extensions](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/67e727126d43f52d.BhEprZ35.webp)![Extensions](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/67e727126d43f52d.BhEprZ35.webp)Extensions Learn how to extend SurrealDB with custom modules and WASM plugins.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/extensions)
##  Features[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#features)
SurrealDB is built around a rich feature set that supports a wide variety of application requirements. Rather than requiring you to stitch together separate systems for different data models or capabilities, SurrealDB provides them all within a single engine.
[ ![Real-time queries](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/652b609078ac988f.CQbm63Bm.webp)![Real-time queries](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/652b609078ac988f.CQbm63Bm.webp)Real-time queries Subscribe to live queries and changefeeds for real-time data updates.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/querying/real-time/live-queries)[ ![Authentication](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/037a996120148e0b.BE0jwzny.webp)![Authentication](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/037a996120148e0b.BE0jwzny.webp)Authentication Built-in authentication and access control with scoped permissions.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/security/authentication/overview)[ ![Graph relationships](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/fa3a0b2d9a4bf2b0.B0nwMsxQ.webp)![Graph relationships](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/fa3a0b2d9a4bf2b0.B0nwMsxQ.webp)Graph relationships Model and traverse complex relationships using native graph edges.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/data-models/graph/overview)[ ![Vector search](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/3ccd7e9a3e883ef4.CzJpPS_D.webp)![Vector search](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/3ccd7e9a3e883ef4.CzJpPS_D.webp)Vector search Store embeddings and perform similarity searches for AI and RAG workflows.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/learn/data-models/vector-search/overview)[ ![Data migrations](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/6bd1b97cabb7013b.X-2MfInD.webp)![Data migrations](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/6bd1b97cabb7013b.X-2MfInD.webp)Data migrations Evolve your database schema over time with SurrealKit.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/explore/surrealist)[ ![Surrealist UI](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/ce57872c785aab9a.BKIL_OUF.webp)![Surrealist UI](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/ce57872c785aab9a.BKIL_OUF.webp)Surrealist UI A native UI to visually explore and manage your SurrealDB data.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/explore/surrealist)
##  SDKs[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#sdks)
SurrealDB offers official SDKs for popular languages, supporting queries, authentication, real-time updates, and in some cases, embedded use. See your chosen language’s docs for setup and examples.
[Go](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/golang)[Java](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/java)[JavaScript](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/javascript/overview)[Kotlin](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/kotlin)[Mojo](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/mojo)[.NET](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/dotnet)[PHP](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/php)[Python](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/python)[Rust](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/rust/overview)[Swift](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/swift)
##  Deployment[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#deployment)
SurrealDB offers flexible deployment options to suit your infrastructure requirements. You can run the database as a fully managed cloud service, self-host it on your own servers, deploy it within containers, or embed it directly into your application.

##  Integrations[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#integrations)
SurrealDB connects with third-party tools, data management platforms, AI frameworks, and embeddings providers. It also supports AI agent workflows, with guides for connecting agents to the database.
[ ![Integrations](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/4d1e067d250e3da7.S2JLkPuw.webp)![Integrations](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/4d1e067d250e3da7.S2JLkPuw.webp)Integrations Connect SurrealDB to third-party tools, AI frameworks, embeddings providers, and data management platforms.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/build/integrations)[ ![AI agents](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/bc4b209868329b4b.BZltwUfK.webp)![AI agents](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/bc4b209868329b4b.BZltwUfK.webp)AI agents Build AI agent workflows that use SurrealDB for knowledge storage, retrieval, and state management.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/build/ai-agents)
##  Developer reference[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#developer-reference)
The reference documentation provides comprehensive, detailed specifications for all SurrealDB interfaces. This includes the full SurrealQL query language with syntax definitions, as well as the command-line interface for managing SurrealDB instances and the HTTP-based REST API for programmatic access.
[ ![SurrealQL](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/6a49b166e27942d6.DXukNZZh.webp)![SurrealQL](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/6a49b166e27942d6.DXukNZZh.webp)SurrealQL Complete query language reference covering statements, functions, data types, and operators.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/query-language)[ ![CLI tools](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/2c6d5014b905a65c.CTTSomQ5.webp)![CLI tools](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/2c6d5014b905a65c.CTTSomQ5.webp)CLI tools Command-line interface reference for starting, managing, and interacting with SurrealDB.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/cli)[ ![REST API](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/351a1aef50fa5125.Doqp2n0s.webp)![REST API](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/351a1aef50fa5125.Doqp2n0s.webp)REST API HTTP API reference for querying and managing SurrealDB over REST endpoints.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/reference/rest-api)
##  Tutorials and resources[](https://surrealdb.com/docs#tutorials-and-resources)
If you prefer learning through practical examples, the tutorials and demos section provides hands-on guides that walk you through common use cases and application patterns. The labs section offers experimental projects and community-contributed content for exploring SurrealDB in different contexts.
[ ![Tutorials and demos](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/6230c2d26c7fb874.D7Ubpt42.webp)![Tutorials and demos](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/6230c2d26c7fb874.D7Ubpt42.webp)Tutorials and demos Step-by-step guides and example projects covering common SurrealDB use cases.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/explore/tutorials)[ ![Labs](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/45e2ed33c14f0b04.BvTtWZUs.webp)![Labs](https://surrealdb.com/docs/assets/static/45e2ed33c14f0b04.BvTtWZUs.webp)Labs Experimental projects and community content for exploring SurrealDB capabilities.](https://surrealdb.com/docs/labs)
